findings.text: follow-on: the tracked-receipt digest guard cannot fire in the head arm — the test writes its ladder receipt to tmp_path/"receipt.json" (line 706) and never writes TRACKED_RECEIPT (docs/figures/constraint-augmented-newton-krylov/shafranov-integral/receipt.json), so the assertion that its SHA-256 is unchanged is satisfied without discriminating anything at head; unlike the certificate renderer guard, the node's negative control exercises only tests/test_certificate_gate_live.py::test_rerendered_part_receipt_is_not_a_live_certificate_row, so this second guard's ability to catch a reintroduced tracked write is asserted rather than measured.

follow-on: the base arm at 05e0b2b14 is contaminated by the bug under repair — at that revision _render_persisted_row resolves FIGURE_ROOT/Path(logical).name, so the certificate and diagnostics tests rewrite tracked figures and four of the six base failures are pollution-cascade failures in tests/test_figure_panel_pin.py and tests/test_certificate_pin.py, files the fix never touches; the delta 6 failed/68 passed to 2 failed/72 passed therefore measures the removal of the renderer's tracked writes together with the cascade they caused, and the head arm (2 failed 72 passed 1 skipped) is the measurement that carries the change. added_failure_count stays 0 because both head failures are present in the base set.

follow-on: after the restore, _render_persisted_row resolves ROOT / logical and no longer follows FIGURE_ROOT, so the reposed-certificate flows at benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:4356 (_measure_reposed_certificate_500) and :4402 (_measure_reposed_certificate), which rebind the module globals FIGURE_ROOT and PART_ROOT before calling _measure, have no effect on where a persisted part's panel is rendered; this matches the pre-hygiene resolution at 97aeeabba (which also used ROOT / row["figure"]["filesystem_path"]), so it is not a regression against the long-standing behaviour, but the rebinding idiom now misleads a reader and the reposed flows need a GPU to exercise, so it is recorded rather than fixed.

item_verdicts.call_sites: none; _render_persisted_row has one in-tree caller (benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:2240) and it passes path=None
item_verdicts.diff: read commit 2cbb536d8 against base 05e0b2b14; it changes benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:2169 from FIGURE_ROOT / Path(logical).name to ROOT / logical and drops the mkdir line, adds a _sha256 helper and a monkeypatch on certificate.ROOT plus a tracked-digest guard to tests/test_certificate_gate_live.py, adds a tracked-receipt digest guard to tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py, and adds the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the node's measure is that the renderer-root regression is repaired and the two tests that render a stored part confine their write and pin what they once dirtied; met — the gate over the four modules gives 2 failed 72 passed 1 skipped at 2cbb536d8 against 6 failed 68 passed 1 skipped at 05e0b2b14, git status --porcelain is clean of tracked figures, and the certificate tracked-write guard is shown to fire (negative control names the rewritten weak-rotation 300-cell PNG, EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal restores the persisted-row renderer's repository-root resolution that the test-hygiene change broke, and hardens the two tests that render a stored part so a reintroduced tracked write fails them; benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:2169 now reads ROOT / logical, and this is the exact resolution the pre-hygiene revision 97aeeabba carried (ROOT / row["figure"]["filesystem_path"]), so the prior review's blocking finding (the renderer change reddening three tests/test_figure_panel_pin.py tests the gate never ran) is resolved.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, commit 2cbb536d8, both suite arms with module-qualified ids, the negative-control path, the two pre-existing failures with a scratch base arm for the stale pin, and git-clean verification, but its baseline arm is contaminated by the bug under repair and its after_suite names the short revision 2cbb536d8 rather than the full head sha the gate log header carries.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's four declared paths; git diff 05e0b2b14..2cbb536d8 touches only benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py, tests/test_certificate_gate_live.py, tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py and docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/cfs-renderer-root-repair.html, all inside them, and no other nova/ or media/ source.

justifications.durability: the confirmed guard is durable: tests/test_certificate_gate_live.py records the tracked digest before the render and asserts the same digest after, a relative comparison robust to future media-content shifts, and it is shown to fire by the negative control; but the second guard in tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py is not negative-controlled and cannot fire at head because the test writes only tmp_path, so half the claimed protection is asserted rather than demonstrated.
justifications.evidence: both suite arms, a scratch pre-hygiene base arm for the residual failure and a negative control are recorded and the head arm reproduces (2 failed 72 passed 1 skipped, EXIT=1), and git status --porcelain is clean of tracked figures after the gate; but the baseline arm is contaminated by the bug's own tracked writes, so its six failures mix renderer-root defects with pollution-cascade failures in untouched files, and the negative control exercises only one of the two new guards.
justifications.fit: the changed line restores the module's own long-standing idiom (ROOT / logical) and the new helper _sha256 and the TRACKED_RECEIPT constant are descriptive names carrying no plan, phase, version or ticket label; the evidence fragment follows the converged-forward-solve fragment convention, with a trivial missing trailing newline only.
justifications.goal_fidelity: benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:2169 restores exactly the pre-hygiene resolution confirmed at 97aeeabba, tests/test_certificate_gate_live.py::test_rerendered_part_receipt_is_not_a_live_certificate_row now confines its render by patching certificate.ROOT to tmp_path beside PART_ROOT and FIGURE_ROOT, and the head arm turns the three tests/test_figure_panel_pin.py tests the prior review flagged from failing to passing with no added failures, so the repair meets its goal.
justifications.reuse: the change is two lines in _render_persisted_row, reuses the module's existing part-fixture idiom and the pytest monkeypatch tmp_path machinery rather than adding a new helper tree, and adds one small _sha256 helper used by the two guards; the removed mkdir was itself introduced by the change being reverted, so dropping it restores the pre-hygiene form rather than deleting live functionality.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 05e0b2b14..2cbb536d8 touches only the four declared write paths, edits no source outside them, adds no plan or ticket identifier to names or comments, and the reviewed worktree at 2cbb536d8 is clean under git status --porcelain.
